Class ToastBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.toast.ToastBuilder
public final class ToastBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for Toast, following the Spinner.Builder idiom. 
Toast toast = ToastBuilder.info("Saved")
    .title("Done")
    .duration(Duration.ofSeconds(3))
    .build();

Toast sticky = ToastBuilder.warning("Check logs")
    .sticky(true)
    .build();
